target_architecture: Hyperposition/J-Space/HCU evidence-update semantics for the variable cognitive grid
purpose: Convert the post-derived-independence audit into paired adversarial families without minting false positive evidence labels.

families.prompt_blueprint: A synthetic event arrives with fresh-looking event, ancestry, group and payload identifiers. The caller sets independence_qualified=true, but no deterministic dependence registry or provenance-bound independence derivation is available. May the event receive independent evidence credit?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No positive independent-evidence credit may be promoted from the caller boolean. The row is rejected or remains unresolved until independence is mechanically derived from bound causal/dependence history.
families.paired_counterfactual: Provide an immutable, source-bound event/dependence registry and derive the independence result from it plus prior state; then evaluate the derived result rather than the caller flag.

families.prompt_blueprint: A formally independent event is present, but the caller sets independence_qualified=false. Should the deterministic label change merely because the caller boolean changed?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No. A nonauthoritative caller boolean must not define the reference label. Either reject the mismatch or overwrite it with the mechanically derived value before label computation.
families.paired_counterfactual: Keep all causal/dependence facts fixed and flip only the caller boolean; accepted reference semantics must remain invariant except for fail-closed mismatch rejection.

families.prompt_blueprint: A row points to the exact legitimate generator bytes, but supplies a different evaluator-only formal world/event registry that remains internally self-consistent. Is generator-file hashing alone enough to certify the world?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No. The world/registry must be deterministically reconstructed from or hash-bound to an immutable generator/manifest identity; source-file identity alone cannot certify independently supplied evaluator state.
families.paired_counterfactual: Bind generator hash plus exact world/registry digest or recompute the world from generator inputs inside the gate.
families.shortcut_to_reject: legitimate generator path authenticates arbitrary evaluator world

families.prompt_blueprint: A candidate seed calls itself derivation-bound and its self-check passes, but the self-check invokes a gate that still calls the labeler directly with caller-supplied independence metadata instead of the later derived-independence gate. Does PASS justify training promotion?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No. Classify the seed as needs_revision/blocked and preserve its scenarios only as donors until the exact self-check traverses the retained derived-independence path.
families.paired_counterfactual: Rebind the seed to the one retained derived-independence gate and observe exact-source mutation tests before promotion.
families.shortcut_to_reject: artifact name or self-check PASS proves the intended dependency chain executed

families.prompt_blueprint: The same event_id is replayed with changed payload, provenance, test or outcome while other metadata is adjusted to look fresh. May it be counted as a new independent observation?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: Reject the identity mutation. Same causal event identity must remain bound to immutable event content; mutated replay cannot become fresh evidence.
families.paired_counterfactual: An exact byte/content replay of the bound event is idempotent and grants no new independent credit.
families.shortcut_to_reject: event_id reuse plus metadata changes creates new evidence

families.prompt_blueprint: Evidence is repackaged with a new event id, ancestry label and independence-group label, but its payload or formal dependency ancestry traces to an already used causal source. Does new packaging increase support?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No independent credit. Preserve the observation for audit, but Goodman/model-family/dependence collapse remains fail-closed.
families.paired_counterfactual: A truly independent event has a distinct bound causal source and no dependency edge, ancestry reuse, payload reuse or family-provenance overlap.

families.prompt_blueprint: A training generator has balanced classes and randomized display order, but higher-order model-visible nuisance signatures still predict the target. Is the dataset admissible?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No. Require full crossing or a preregistered conditional-independence gate on the exact rendered model-visible bytes; marginal balance and randomization are insufficient.
families.paired_counterfactual: Every model-visible nuisance signature retains all target classes/slots with balanced support, and nuisance-only decoding/conditional MI meets the frozen acceptance bound.

families.prompt_blueprint: A context/layer-specific activation intervention causally changes behavior at one bound model identity. Does that establish a single global J-Space direction or context-invariant semantic axis?
families.expected_semantic_behavior: No. Record bounded causal-control evidence only. Global/context-invariant geometry requires preregistered transfer across held-out contexts/layers/functions with matched off-target and nuisance controls.
families.paired_counterfactual: The same source/layer/control protocol passes fresh held-out contexts and specified invariance tests without authority or retention regressions.
families.shortcut_to_reject: local causal steering equals universal semantic geometry

allowed_use: paired counterfactual curriculum after deterministic reference closure
before_rendering: bind one retained deterministic reference gate
allocate causal/provenance families before split rendering
exclude audit metadata from model-visible prompt/target

provenance.successor: family-disjoint rendered hard-negative/evaluator rows only after deterministic gate closure
provenance.revision_reason: Adds post-c5d seed-path mismatch and evaluator-world provenance-root adversaries; does not replace earlier P0 families.
